Despite initial doubts, the farm has become a popular destination for families and children.

stories.title: Inside Chloë Grace Moretz’s former $5.65 M Los Angeles home
stories.summary: Chloë Grace Moretz purchased a $3.4 million home in Studio City in 2016 and hosted numerous gatherings there. After seven years, she listed the property for almost $6 million and sold it for $5.65 million. The home features multiple entertainment spaces, a separate studio, and luxurious outdoor areas. Studio City remains a popular area for high-profile buyers, including Olivia Wilde, who sold her property in December 2025.

stories.title: How Cameron Diaz turned a $1.8 Million home into $4.9 million
stories.summary: Ariana Grande acquired Cameron Diaz's Hollywood Hills property in 2022 through an off-market deal worth $4.9 million. The home features two bedrooms, two-and-a-half bathrooms, and is situated at the end of a cul-de-sac. Cameron Diaz originally bought the house in 2004 for $1.8 million but never lived there. The property underwent many renovations during Diaz's ownership, enhancing its condition before Grande's purchase.

stories.title: Aspen Estate Sale Closes: Slack and Away founders net $5m gain; sale not linked to separation
stories.summary: Stewart Butterfield and Jen Rubio recently finalized the sale of their Aspen estate for $30 million, right after their separation. They originally acquired the property for around $25 million in January 2021, yielding a nice profit despite initially aiming for $45 million. The estate has been purchased by David and Erika Sands, professional poker players, who now add it to their diverse real estate holdings across New York and California.

stories.title: Laid off on H-1B, 1 interview after 100 applications: Redditor shares harrowing job situation in US
Bob Barker’s historic Los Angeles mansion sells for $6.325 million after renovation
stories.summary: A charming piece of Hollywood Hills history, the home once owned by Bob Barker has seen an impressive makeover. Julia Dempster, the interior designer, cleverly blended modern enhancements with the house's original charm, showcasing stunning stained-glass windows and wrought iron accents. Originally listed at over $8 million, it found a new owner, Randy Pitchford, for $6.325 million in spring 2026, further enriching his portfolio of Hollywood landmarks.

stories.title: After Operation Sindoor friction, Delhi & Baku reset ties with EAM Jaishankar's visit
stories.summary: Ties between the two countries had been held back by geopolitical reasons for a while, mainly Azerbaijan’s ties with Pakistan — as evident from its support for Islamabad after Op Sindoor last year — and India’s defence ties with Armenia. While Bayramov spoke about taking the relationship to a higher level, setting aside past differences, Jaishankar underlined the significance of trade and energy cooperation. Terrorism was also discussed.

stories.title: Study traces how an El Niño changed the pollution map
stories.summary: Coming ahead of India’s peak pollution season, the paper, titled ‘Air quality in flux: The baffling ENSO transition in India’, published in Atmospheric Pollution Research journal Thursday, found that La Niña/El Niño conditions altered atmospheric circulation, PM2.5 transport pathways and weather conditions that determine whether pollution disperses or gets trapped.

stories.title: Cabinet Secretary didn’t act on Election Commissioners’ plaint as it was unofficial: RTI
stories.summary: According to documents shared as part of an RTI response, two ECs in their separate but near-identical letters to Somanathan on July 29 objected to Garg’s conduct and an order he issued revising allocation of work among senior officers. The two ECs alleged the changes were made without prior discussion with the commission or officers concerned.

stories.title: Cabinet secretariat merely acknowledged complaint of ECs against senior poll officer: RTI
stories.summary: Explaining the rationale behind the reluctance to take any action, a confidential note on the file shared by the Cabinet secretariat with transparency activist, Commodore Lokesh K Batra (Retd), as part of its 21-page RTI reply, stated that EC being a Constitutional body is insulated from the Executive's interference by design.

stories.title: China’s patrolling deviations disturb border: MEA on ITBP DG's LAC face-offs remark
stories.summary: The ministry of external affairs (MEA) on Friday did not go into the specifics of the latest face-off, choosing to refer the issue to the defence ministry, but said Chinese divergence from established patrolling patterns created disturbances at the border from time to time. The official said both sides continued to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC.

stories.title: Northwest India turned drier, south wetter over 70 years, finds IMD study
stories.summary: In northwest India, the hot semi-arid zone grew from about a quarter of the region’s area in 1951-1980 to a third in 1991-2020, while the temperate zone shrank from about a quarter to less than a fifth, meaning that an area equal to roughly 7% of the region moved into the drier zone as temperatures rose and rainfall declined, said the study.

stories.title: How Huda Kattan took Huda Beauty from a $6,000 loan to full founder ownership
New car safety rules: Rear-crash tests from 2029 to prevent fire, immobilisers from 2027
stories.summary: The ministry has set mandatory timelines for automakers to comply with other Automotive Industry Standards (AIS), covering occupant protection in offset frontal and lateral collisions, protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users, and fitment of immobilisers. The requirements will come into effect from April 2027 onwards. In a notification, the ministry also made AIS-192 mandatory for Event Data Recorders (EDRs) installed in cars from Oct 2029.

stories.title: Lucy Hale's $2.95M LA home gets a colourful makeover after Sobriety
Indian-American student terminated from campus news website after he voted for Democrat in Texas
Arms training case: US mercenary VanDyke, 6 Ukrainians to remain abroad till Feb 24
stories.summary: VanDyke attended the court hearing Friday and sought the release of his seized personal articles. The seven accused had earlier sought six weeks to meet their families and were allowed to stay abroad till Oct 23. They were arrested on March 13 for allegedly training the insurgent-linked groups in Myanmar.

stories.title: Opposition's 'mock Parliament' to step up fight against SIR & CEC Gyanesh Kumar
stories.summary: Sources said a “mock” gathering depicting an assembly of MPs may take place in the national capital on Oct 28. The event will involve MPs and others, but is unlikely to be a large gathering, given that a massive show of strength to push for the CEC’s resignation is planned at Ramlila Maidan as a “Delhi chalo” rally.

stories.title: Need to unite against divisive forces, tackle new challenges: PM Modi
stories.summary: Inaugurating the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan, he said Swami Chinmayananda set his goals as per issues facing the country at the time and new challenges had emerged in the past few decades. “We must unite society against divisive forces. We must inspire citizens toward self-reliance, and we must connect every individual to vision of a developed India by 2047. For these objectives, we must become more proactive,” he said.

stories.title: Centre bans reuse of single-use medical devices across hospitals; flags recycling of disposables
stories.summary: In a letter dated Oct 16, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) said it had come to its notice that some private and corporate hospitals were reusing single-use devices after sterilising them, including items used in cardiology, nephrology, oncology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery (CTVS), neurosurgery and other clinical services. The DGHS said that reuse could expose patients to cross-infection, device malfunction, reduced performance and other complications.

stories.title: Brics parliamentary meet should end with joint statement: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla
stories.summary: Talking to reporters Friday, Birla said the forum in India would work towards consensus-based dialogue on the role of Parliament in strengthening institutions, promotion of human-centred innovation in AI and digital technologies through Parliament, more representative system of global governance and role of Parliament in ensuring a sustainable and inclusive future for Brics countries.

stories.title: Massachusetts buyer challenges $3.85 million loan after demolishing his home
$38,000 to $40,000 per fake marriage: Fraud for Green Card busted
Jason Momoa’s water brand expands hotel refill machines after removing 6 million plastic bottles
stories.summary: Mananalu, founded by Jason Momoa, aims to eliminate single-use plastic bottles through innovative refill systems. The newly implemented technology connects to local water sources and fills reusable containers. This approach also significantly reduces carbon emissions associated with traditional bottled water. Initiatives are starting in Hawaii, where waste management is crucial due to heavy reliance on imported water.

stories.title: Trump says he will talk to Musk if Ukraine's Starlink issues persist
Parl panel bats for intercensal surveys, gender-inclusive census town norms
Rhode Island volunteers reused 600+ Christmas trees to restore riverbanks and protect young trout
stories.summary: In an inspiring environmental effort, volunteers in Rhode Island gathered over 600 old Christmas trees for the 'Trees for Trout' initiative, aimed at restoring riverbanks. By bringing their discarded trees to designated collection sites at Arcadia Management Area, residents have made a significant contribution toward creating sustainable trout habitats and mitigating soil erosion. This project not only enhances local waterways but also promotes community involvement in ecological preservation.

stories.title: 1890 Sherlock Holmes first edition found in charity shop sells for £11,520
stories.summary: A first-edition edition of The Sign of Four surfaced among the book donations at an Oxfam shop, piquing the interest of staff who recognized its rare value. After seeking expert appraisal, the book fetched an impressive £11,520 at Bonhams auction house. The funds raised will greatly benefit Oxfam's humanitarian efforts globally, highlighting how valuable donations can be when assessed properly.

stories.title: Portia gifted Ellen a Rwanda gorilla project in 2018; its campus welcomed 40,000+ visitors by 2023
stories.summary: Portia de Rossi gifted Ellen DeGeneres a conservation project which led to the Ellen DeGeneres Campus opening in Rwanda. The campus supports wildlife protection and offers educational opportunities for local students and communities. Since its opening, it has welcomed numerous visitors and hosted thousands of Rwandan schoolchildren for science lessons. The project emphasizes sustainable practices and aims to monitor and protect endangered mountain gorillas.

stories.title: US midterms 2026: Mark Carney rejects US claim of election interference, says 'no merit'
Alicia Keys and Swizz Beatz bought a $20.8M California cliffside home in 2019
stories.summary: Alicia Keys and Swizz Beatz made a significant purchase in 2019, acquiring the Razor House in La Jolla for $20.8 million. This architectural masterpiece, designed by Wallace E. Cunningham, boasts panoramic Pacific Ocean views. The duo transformed this modern creation into a warm family abode, enriched with artworks from the Dean Collection, reflecting Swizz Beatz's dream of a creative hideaway and highlighting the prestige of California's architectural landscape.

stories.title: Gurjar Mahasabha flags lack of political representation, seeks greater share in legislatures, institutions
stories.summary: Scheduled for October 27, the Akhil Bharatiya Gurjar Mahasabha's national convention aims to tackle pressing representation issues faced by the Gurjar community, evidenced by just 20 MLAs in a pool of approximately 4,600 across India. Key demands include the formation of a Gurjar Regiment and reserved positions, as well as initiatives focused on youth development and substance abuse awareness.

stories.title: US midterms 2026: Trump admin files lawsuit over Alaska Senate race, seeks to block results if GOP loses
Jamia protest: Congress MP Imran Masood detained, SP MP alleges manhandling by police
Butterflies Rebound After Restoration: Ex-wheat farm records 5,290 in 2026; rare species appear
stories.summary: Halnaker Hill Farm in West Sussex has experienced a remarkable surge in butterfly populations thanks to dedicated habitat restoration initiatives. In the spring of 2026, surveys noted 5,290 butterflies representing 28 different species, including some that are quite rare. This ecological project has fostered a rich variety of habitats that not only attract butterflies but also support bird life and other insects.

stories.title: Fodder scam accused nabbed after 25 years, had fled to Nepal
'Ugh. They are Black': NYC broker typed text for property owners, mistakenly sent to the couple hunting for apartments
In 2017, J.J. Watt donated $100K for Hurricane Harvey relief, raised $41.6M to help Texas flood victims
stories.summary: In 2017, former NFL star J.J. Watt donated $100,000 to launch a fundraiser for Hurricane Harvey victims in Texas. Initially targeting $200,000, the campaign eventually raised $41.6 million by August 2018. The money helped rebuild more than 600 homes, restore over 420 childcare centres, distribute 26 million meals and provide healthcare to thousands.

stories.title: 71-year-old man killed as Tesla in full self-driving mode hits him on California freeway

Montana conservation group bought 70,000-acre ranch once owned by Texas billionaires
stories.summary: American Prairie's recent acquisition of Anchor Ranch in Montana expanded its land portfolio by 70,000 acres. With a vision to establish the largest nature preserve in the Lower 48, the purchase also includes part of Bullwhacker Road, enhancing access to public lands. Although some critics raise concerns about increased land values impacting ranching profitability, the current ranching families leasing the land will continue operating as usual.

stories.title: Chinese woman breaks 5 ribs from hug, husband says he used normal force, wife does not get sunlight, does extreme dieting
Maine tenants win $3.6m deal after rent-control dispute
stories.summary: The Trelawny Tenants Union has achieved a significant milestone, settling for $3.6 million with landlord Geoffrey Rice over improper rent hikes. This reimbursement, affecting more than 1,000 residents for overpayments since 2020, stems from ongoing mediation and legal challenges against violations of rent control laws. Moving forward, the union plans to enforce compliance among landlords in Portland and is exploring a digitized rental registration system for better governance.

stories.title: Gosling and Mendes bought Joel Schumacher’s California retreat, built from 200-year-old barn timber
stories.summary: In 2014, Ryan Gosling and Eva Mendes purchased a distinctive rustic estate in Carpinteria, California. This property, crafted by Joel Schumacher, is constructed from reclaimed wood of three 200-year-old barns. Designed for privacy and a serene connection to nature, it embodies American history, offering a tranquil retreat from Los Angeles. The couple cherishes their family life away from the spotlight, valuing their children and preserving the estate's unique features.

stories.title: Lauren Conrad’s ‘Laguna Beach’ family mansion, built by James Conrad in 2004, listed for $26.5 million
stories.summary: Lauren Conrad’s family mansion, featured in MTV’s Laguna Beach: The Real Orange County, is listed for $26.5 million. Designed and built in 2004 by her father, architect James Conrad, the nearly 8,000-square-foot Mediterranean-style estate overlooks the Pacific Ocean. Located in Laguna Beach’s exclusive Three Arch Bay community, the property features six bedrooms, an infinity-edge pool and private beach access.

Trump and Vance back Ramaswamy despite campaign fiasco that could damage Republicans

Albert Einstein's 100-year-old handwritten letter filled with equations sells for $71,811
stories.summary: A handwritten letter by Albert Einstein, believed to date back to around 1929, has sold for $71,811 at RR Auction. Addressed to mathematician Chaim Herman Muntz, the one-page document contains detailed equations exploring Hamiltonian mechanics, covariance and invariance. Written in German, the letter was sold with its original envelope, postmarked in Potsdam, offering a glimpse into Einstein's mathematical discussions nearly a century ago.

A rare 1800s Washington folk art drawing, hidden for 60 years, sold at auction for $226,600
stories.summary: A remarkable early 19th-century folk art piece, showcasing George Washington, has achieved a staggering auction price of $226,600 after lying dormant for 60 years. This striking artwork embodies the fraktur tradition of Pennsylvania German heritage, adorned with patriotic imagery. The strong interest stemmed from its superb condition and rich historical context, illustrating the enduring passion for distinguished American folk art among collectors and institutions alike.

stories.title: Lauren Conrad bought a $1.35M Beverly Hills penthouse, rebuilt it, sold it for $2.8M
stories.summary: Lauren Conrad, known for The Hills, sold her renovated Beverly Hills penthouse for $2.8 million. She initially purchased the property for $1.35 million four years earlier. After extensive renovations, she transformed the space into a modern home with high-end finishes. The penthouse includes a large open-plan living area, multiple bedrooms, and outdoor terraces. Conrad's real estate ventures in Southern California continue to show significant financial returns.

stories.title: Man spent over 20 years restoring Spitfire aircraft in UK garage; project sells for £18,000
stories.summary: Peter Arnold, affectionately dubbed 'Mr Spitfire', dedicated over half a century to amassing historic aircraft relics. After his passing in 2025, a remarkable unfinished Spitfire fuselage went under the hammer for £18,000. This Spitfire F Mk 22 PK519 fuselage featured original components, resting in Arnold's garage for 20 years. Besides the fuselage, auctioned treasures included vintage aircraft instruments and a mesmerizing clock.

stories.title: Eric Weinstein asks why there's raw hatred against Indians, Hindus; Sridhar Vembu says, 'Until India develops...'
'Always respected': Uttarakhand CM Dhami calls Daler Mehndi days after on-stage row
Three fathers cleaned a creek for their kids; 50 neighbours joined the cause

'What happened to Abdul in Telangana?' Congress leader questions Owaisi's 'own leadership' call to Muslims in poll-bound UP
‘Murder of democracy’: Raj Thackeray targets BJP over ‘Rs 500 crore payment’ audio clip
New York family blocks road with tree trunks, court awards it to neighbouring club
stories.summary: In a landmark ruling, a New York family has lost their claim to a shared private road that now belongs to a nearby recreational club. This road, previously amicably used for decades, became contentious in 2021 when disagreements over access arose. The state’s highest court ultimately sided with the club, citing its historical maintenance and usage, despite the family's assertions of permission based on their long-term relationship.

stories.title: 'Movement will continue': Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das appear before SEM
Tanker carrying Russian diesel heads to US days after Trump’s surprise deal with Moscow
New York couple's $6.83 million divorce award upheld after appeals court reviews business interests and payments
stories.summary: In a recent high-profile divorce case, Shirley F. Atkins emerged victorious with a settlement of $6.83 million from James C. Atkins. The appeals court affirmed her entitlement to 22.5% of his business interests and stock sale proceeds. Both sides presented compelling arguments to adjust this percentage. Furthermore, the court ruled on tax responsibilities and payment structures, illustrating its power in equitable asset distribution during divorce proceedings.

stories.title: 'Won't tolerate vote theft': Anti-SIR protesters try to march to EC HQ, many detained
Punjab polls: Badal praises SAD-BJP rule as Amit Shah’s NDA pitch fuels reunion buzz
stories.summary: Indicating a readiness for alliances, Sukhbir Singh Badal has echoed the sentiments of the Shiromani Akali Dal in seeking partnerships with similar-minded political entities. Recently, Amit Shah hinted at a future NDA governance in Punjab, fueling rumors of a SAD-BJP reunion. However, the Punjab BJP president emphasized that a formal alliance is not yet in place.

stories.title: Canadian conservation club with just 4 members to donate nearly 100-acre forest to university for honeybee research
stories.summary: A conservation club plans to transfer nearly 100 acres of land on Thorah Island to the University of Guelph. This site has been dedicated to honeybee breeding research for over thirty years. The donation aims to maintain the land for conservation and research instead of development. The University of Guelph will continue its long-term apiary operation critical to honeybee genetics work.

stories.title: Winston Churchill’s 1948 painting sells for £716,800; proceeds to fund arts programme
stories.summary: Winston Churchill's artwork, Amaryllis Lily, fetched an impressive £716,800 at auction, with proceeds directed toward the Churchill Fellowship. This funding will bolster the Making Space for the Arts initiative, aimed at increasing public participation in the arts. The piece, which has a fascinating legacy, was originally given to Churchill's daughter before being donated. This auction not only exceeded expectations but also empowers the charity to support significant artistic community initiatives.

stories.title: 'No tweet yet for Raihan Vadra': BJP floats 'Priyanka vs Rahul' angle amid Bikaner House exhibition row
Indiana homeowner damages shared garden, calls it maintenance; appeals court upholds HOA injunction
stories.summary: In a legal showdown, Indiana resident Martin L. Booth clashed with the Efroymson House Owner's Association over alleged vandalism of shared garden spaces, including shrubs, flowers, and lighting. The Indiana Court of Appeals upheld an injunction against Booth, highlighting the HOA's ownership of common areas. Despite Booth's claim of property rights, the court affirmed evidence of his destructive actions, siding with the HOA.

stories.title: Myanmar arms training case: Court allows US mercenary VanDyke, 6 Ukrainians to stay abroad till Feb 24
Hebron Lockdown Ordered: Netanyahu plans full West Bank closure; attack heightens election fears
stories.summary: In response to a recent shooting near Hebron, Israel has enacted a total closure of the occupied West Bank, citing rising security concerns as the Israeli elections approach. The alleged gunmen were reportedly neutralized, and authorities have put up roadblocks, imposing strict limitations on Palestinian movement. This has sparked vigorous discussions around security protocols and the implications for Palestinian civilians.

stories.title: ‘Chai, samosa, rasmalai’: Hoardings target Akhilesh Yadav over 'mafia links' in Lucknow
stories.summary: In a striking development in Lucknow, hoardings targeting Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav have emerged, linking him to controversial gangster-politicians. This controversial move followed Yadav's visit to convicted politician Mohammad Azam Khan, raising eyebrows and criticism from the BJP. Yadav claims the ruling party is fabricating charges against Khan and his kin, citing a harsh political onslaught by the BJP as the motive.

stories.title: Florida mother seeks child support from ex, court adds new husband's $8,600 bills to her income
stories.summary: A Florida appeals court has determined that child support calculations will be revisited in a contentious family dispute. Bianca Rampartap sought a review after her ex-husband halted his parenting time. The earlier court wrongly counted his financial contributions as income for Bianca, leading her to appeal. The higher court ruled in her favor, requiring a reexamination of her income and subsequent modifications to child support arrangements.

South Korean rescuers try three times to free shark, but it swims back into canal
stories.summary: A dusky shark, named Bukangi, has remained in the North Port canal in Busan for over a month. Authorities have attempted multiple rescues, but the shark keeps returning to the canal. Experts believe busy port activities may be influencing Bukangi's behavior, making it feel safer in the canal. The shark, which is endangered, has raised concerns due to lack of feeding and falling water temperatures.

stories.title: ‘Stranded Umrah pilgrims being assisted’: Rijiju shares helpline numbers for Indians in Saudi Arabia
Bel Air's 4,500-ton concrete mansion hits market for $36.5 million after nine-year project
stories.summary: A stunning new mansion in Bel Air has hit the market for a cool $36.5 million, slated for completion in 2026. Over a painstaking nine-year period, this exquisite residence was crafted utilizing robust reinforced concrete and expansive glass walls. With six spacious bedrooms and nine lavish bathrooms, it showcases luxury amenities throughout.

stories.title: Old deeds and a 1926 ruling shaped Florida rail land dispute as court rejects trail compensation claims
stories.summary: In a recent ruling, the US Court of Appeals clarified property rights as Florida landowners sought compensation when a railway corridor transformed into a public trail. The court determined that the railway held fee simple ownership of the land, supported by historical deeds and a condemnation judgment, nullifying any reversionary rights for landowners. Ultimately, this ruling emphasizes the significance of historical property rights in present-day legal scenarios.

stories.title: Scottish pickle business supplies 400 shops and targets £500,000 in 2026 sales
Archaeologists uncovered a 15th-century ship beneath Barcelona during car park construction
stories.summary: During the renovation of a former fish market, archaeologists made a fascinating discovery: the remains of the medieval ship Ciutadella I, dating from the 15th and 16th centuries. This vessel, containing around 30 ribs and seven planks, reveals valuable details about the maritime heritage of the region. With conservation measures in place, efforts are focused on safeguarding this archaeological treasure for further exploration and understanding.

stories.title: Ohio lowers Guilford Lake 20 feet for $14M dam repairs, refill set for 2027
'Disgrace at so many levels': Shashi Tharoor reacts to removal of Raihan Vadra's photos from exhibition
Iris Sets Auction Record: Monet canvas fetches €50mn in Paris; France hails new mark
stories.summary: At a Paris auction, Claude Monet's painting titled Iris fetched an astounding 50 million euros, setting a new record for artwork sold in France. The event not only celebrated this remarkable sale but also marked the centenary of Monet's passing, with three more of his exquisite paintings featured at the auction. Additionally, Christie's auction saw impressive sales from a variety of artworks, including several by Monet.

stories.title: Police Labrador rescues missing 70-year-old hiker in Hawaii; he now wants to adopt her
stories.summary: After missing for over a day in Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, 70-year-old David Arai was successfully located by Trina, a skilled police dog, who led the search team through dense foliage. Found two miles from his rental car and suffering from dehydration, Arai expressed immense gratitude to his rescuers and is now contemplating adopting Trina, who has proven her tracking abilities with two recent rescues.

stories.title: Australian farmer turns poultry waste into power, fertiliser and natural food dye
'Can't drive into future looking at rearview mirror': India calls for urgent UNSC reforms
New Study Of Westminster Sarcophagus: Roman coffin holds medieval abbot; identity still debated
stories.summary: Excavations at Westminster Abbey have unveiled a medieval abbot's remains within an ancient Roman coffin, dated to the time between AD 987 and 1052. Notable candidates for the identity of this abbot include Ælfwig and Wulfnoth, who once steered the Westminster Benedictine monastery. The coffin, rich in history, has been preserved and examined since its 19th-century discovery, and today, visitors can appreciate its elaborate inscriptions.

stories.title: Paul Walker founded a Haiti relief group in 2010; it helped 13,093 people in 2025
stories.summary: A decade after the untimely death of actor Paul Walker, his humanitarian endeavor, Reach Out WorldWide, is creating a significant impact. In 2025 alone, ROWW assisted over 13,000 individuals through various global disaster-relief initiatives. This organization mobilizes skilled volunteers to meet immediate community demands following calamities, operating at no cost to families in need, all while upholding Walker's legacy of providing swift assistance during crises.

stories.title: 'Shaurya commandos' prepared: ITBP chief flags ‘ongoing’ China faceoff along Arunachal border
Ontario farmer rejects C$16 million offer to protect his 164-acre fruit farm
stories.summary: Charles Stevens and his family have decided to protect Wilmot Orchards by placing a conservation easement on the property. This easement effectively restricts future development for nearly 1,000 years, ensuring continued agricultural use. Their decision counters pressures from developers seeking to convert farmland into housing. The Stevens family aims to preserve the land for future generations of farmers.

stories.title: Finnish watchmaker Kari Voutilainen’s limited-edition steel watch sells for $1.016 million at auction
stories.summary: At a recent Phillips auction, an exquisite stainless-steel timepiece crafted by renowned watchmaker Kari Voutilainen commanded an impressive $1.016 million, far surpassing its estimated value. The Voutilainen 28Sport Limited Edition features a stunning blue guilloché dial complemented by a striking black onyx center. Originally acquired in 2021, this watch's sale underscores the increasing allure of exceptional and rare watches within the collector community.

stories.title: Portland man turns $48,412 backyard makeover into $85,000 rental business
stories.summary: Rob Nachbar skillfully turned his once-simple backyard in Portland into a thriving rental space known as Pong Springs. This five-year renovation, which cost $48,412, prioritized weather-resistant structures and enhanced privacy features. Since its launch on Swimply, Nachbar has generated approximately $106,000 in revenue. The yard not only hosts various events but also provides the family with a serene private retreat—combining leisure and financial success.

stories.title: Sudan’s RSF fighters deliberately targeted atleast 43 hospitals during el-Fasher siege: Report
stories.summary: A recent BBC investigation has uncovered alarming evidence of the RSF's assault on numerous healthcare facilities in el-Fasher, Sudan. The findings reveal egregious breaches of international humanitarian law and suggest potential war crimes. The conflict has tragically resulted in healthcare workers being killed, injured, or kidnapped, significantly worsening the humanitarian crisis. UN officials have characterized the situation as possessing attributes of genocide due to persistent ethnic hostilities.

stories.title: 2 Election Commissioners complained against poll panel officer, but Cabinet Secretariat took no action: RTI
'Lifting sanctions will make Putin stronger': Zelenskyy on Trump ties

Jason Momoa buys Queenstown estate for NZ$15 million, NZ$3.5 million above valuation
stories.summary: Jason Momoa has recently acquired a significant property in Queenstown, New Zealand for NZ$15 million. The estate, formerly owned by Sir Sam Neill, demonstrates the increasing interest in the local real estate market. Property values in the region have risen significantly, attracting overseas buyers. Momoa has deep connections to New Zealand, having visited frequently for leisure and work. He has also invested in the local film industry and nightlife scene.

stories.title: Texas farmer grows from 27 to 10,000 sheep by grazing solar farms across 40,000 acres
stories.summary: JR Howard experienced hardships early on with only a small number of sheep, making it tough to earn a living. However, after landing a grazing contract with solar farms, he expanded his flock and income significantly. This eco-friendly grazing method is being embraced by renewable energy companies as a cost-effective way to manage vegetation, while farmers benefit from expansive grazing land without hefty property expenses.

stories.title: California family spends $4,000 and 200 hours turning its yard into a free Jurassic Park attraction
stories.summary: In Granada Hills, a family has dedicated $4,000 to create an elaborate Jurassic Park-themed display for Halloween. After investing over 200 hours, they've constructed life-sized dinosaur replicas and an automated escape show, complete with grand entrance gates. Open to the public at no cost, this attraction fosters community spirit as neighbors flock to capture the experience and enjoy this festive installation.

stories.title: Congress defaming India to shield Nehru-Gandhi family: PM Modi
stories.summary: “Dimagi naxals have captured Congress so much that it has lost its ability to think. Those who used to cause destruction in forests are now determined to wreak havoc on the country through Congress,” PM Modi said, referring to hardcore Left elements accused of being sympathetic to Maoists and now vocal in protests against EC and govt.

stories.title: Media Losses Cloud Empire: MrBeast’s $5bn business leans on his fame; long-term durability in doubt
stories.summary: MrBeast has transformed his YouTube fame into a business empire valued at $5 billion, spanning chocolate, television and financial technology. His Feastables brand generated $250 million in sales and over $20 million in profit in 2024. However, his media business lost nearly $80 million despite strong revenue. With major investor backing and a fintech acquisition reaching seven million users, MrBeast faces the challenge of turning online popularity into sustainable, profitable businesses.

stories.title: 'Keep it up': Trump backs Ramaswamy's attack ad against Ohio rival
stories.summary: In his post, Trump did not directly address the allegations of abuse but attacked Acton, writing: "I suggested, on the other hand, that Vivek should keep it up, and let everyone listen to the mother of a defective, dishonest, and incapable Candidate, explain how the daughter is a DISASTER who, uncontrollably, lies, cheats, and steals!"

stories.title: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk
stories.summary: Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.

stories.title: Goose Creek Estate Listed: Quirky 1958 ranch hits market at $1.227 million; licensed short-term rental
stories.summary: Nestled at 108 Hampton Avenue, this unique property in Goose Creek is now on the market. It boasts three distinct kitchens, creatively themed bedrooms, and a generous indoor pool. Spanning 5,390 square feet, this estate is perfect for multigenerational families or as a lucrative short-term rental option. The outdoor spaces are ideal for entertaining.

stories.title: Necklace nearly sold for £15 at car boot sale fetches £99,000 at auction
stories.summary: Imagine a dusty car boot sale where a unique necklace fashioned from human hair and whale bone was nearly sold for just £15. Fortunately, it caught the eye of an expert at Ewbank's auction house, revealing its immense worth, which fetched an incredible £99,000 at auction. This story underscores the vital role of appraisals in recognizing hidden treasures that often go unnoticed in clearance sales.

stories.title: In call with Israeli counterpart, PM Modi says urgent need to restore West Asia peace
stories.summary: PM Modi said he had received acall from Netanyahu during which the leaders reviewed the sustained momentum in bilateral ties and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening the partnership. Modi did not mention Netanyahu’s invitation in his post on the conversation. “We exchanged views on developments in West Asia and underscored the urgent need to restore peace and stability in the region,” Modi said on X.

stories.title: Collisions Fall After Wildlife Overpass: I-25 crossings cut crashes by up to 91%; Colorado plans six more
stories.summary: A network of wildlife crossings in Colorado has reduced collisions along Interstate 25 by approximately 85 percent. This system includes fencing, underpasses, and an overpass which opened in December 2025. Recent studies show a significant decline in wildlife-related crashes since the introduction of these measures. Various species, including elk and pronghorn, have begun using these crossings effectively.

stories.title: Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk
stories.summary: PM Modi and his Polish counterpart Tusk expressed deepest concern in a joint statement over the war in Ukraine, including its tragic humanitarian consequences and the impact on Global South. In his media statement, Modi assured Tusk that whether it is Ukraine or West Asia, India will continue to support every meaningful effort for peace.

stories.title: From Jan 1, WhatsApp, Telegram won’t work without SIM cards, govt issues guidelines
stories.summary: The move is to curb cross-border cyber frauds, phishing, digital arrest scams using Indian mobile numbers and enhance telecom cyber security. Apple has updated iOS with a software patch to help detect when an iPhone is operating without a physical SIM card to abide with the rules. It is learnt Signal has not yet responded to govt notices.

stories.title: Govt plans colour-coded driving licence for Indians, foreigners
stories.summary: Life insurance policies, too, would no longer be accepted as proof. Proposing sweeping changes to the driving licence (DL) regime under Motor Vehicles Rules, the road transport ministry Wednesday issued a draft notification to raise the pass mark for the online safe-driving tutorial assessment from the current 60% to 75%.

stories.title: Centre flags data gap, regulatory hurdles in curbing hospital mark-ups
stories.summary: The Union govt has told the SC in its affidavit that margins on hospital consumables can range from 100% to 1,000% or more, highlighting concerns over the high mark-ups patients often face on supplies used during treatment. However, a senior official told TOI that the govt does not have the data needed to assess margins across hospital supplies and determine whether wider controls are warranted.

stories.title: Movie glorifies violence, generalises graft in medical field: IMA
stories.summary: In a letter, dated Oct 22, to I&B minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, IMA national president Dr Anilkumar J Nayak sought an impartial review of the promo video for the upcoming film and appropriate corrective measures from its makers. It also called for a ban or other action if justified under applicable law. The letter was also copied to the Union health and home ministries and the chairperson of National Medical Commission.

stories.title: Don’t blindly follow foreign custody order: Supreme Court
stories.summary: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K V Viswanathan said cases already dealt with by foreign courts were coming before it time and again and their adjudication was not easy as they involved deeply emotional and sensitive issues. It added that the welfare of the child “must be understood in the widest sense, not by money or physical comfort alone”.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi makes Instagram debut, shares first look of her upcoming book
stories.summary: In her first post on Instagram, Sonia shared a video of her welcoming the first copies of her autobiography “Belonging: A journey of love” which is set to be released on Nov 10. The video showed her holding up the book and then sharing sweets with daughter and MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. “It is a story of love, duty, loss and finding a place to belong. I look forward to sharing it with you,” Sonia wrote on the post.

stories.title: Will decide on any notice to remove CEC according to rules: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla
stories.summary: Both the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha chairman had rejected previous notices from the opposition, saying their allegations “do not prima facie meet the high constitutional bar for removal proceedings”. Birla noted the process for removal of the chief election commissioner was the same as for removing a Supreme Court judge.

stories.title: Resignation by Justice Yashwant Varma may end Lok Sabha proceedings
stories.summary: Justice Yashwant Varma’s name still figuring on the list of judges on the HC website had bolstered the view. However, sources said legal opinion, backed by a court verdict, that an HC judge’s resignation comes into effect as soon as he resigns may prevail in what was earlier seen as a legal grey area.

stories.title: MEA calls out UN report for saying Dawood Ibrahim's D-company India-based
stories.summary: First secretary in India’s permanent mission to UN, Raghoo Puri, was responding to a report by Ben Saul, the special rapporteur on the ‘Promotion and Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms while Countering Terrorism’. He said this presented member-states with a fait accompli, an unfortunate situation for an organisation already facing challenges to its legitimacy.

stories.title: Karoline Leavitt says her previous job was obviously not for Katie Zacharia who survived as press secretary for 5 days
Hospitals ‘overcharging’ is a malpractice: Govt to Supreme Court
stories.summary: In an affidavit filed in SC on the issue of capping prices of all medicines and medical consumables, chemicals and fertilisers ministry said that patients have a very low bargaining position with respect to hospitals, resulting in various malpractices. The affidavit noted the irony of India being home to companies making cheap drugs but patients here having to pay way above the manufacturing price, as well as patients being subjected to overcharging by hospitals.

stories.title: After 2005 rat removal, three seabird species on a Pacific island grew up to tenfold over decades
stories.summary: The successful eradication of invasive rodents in 2005 has greatly influenced seabird populations on Surprise Island. Researchers closely monitored seven seabird species to document their recovery post-eradication. While some species thrived quickly, others needed more extended observation to show signs of improvement. Notably, noddies saw a significant increase in breeding pairs, whereas red-footed boobies showed a more gradual recovery.

stories.title: Kuwaiti H-1B doctor in Ohio poisoned girlfriend with abortion drug to terminate pregnancy, became US citizen lying on his Form N-400
Google India, Telegram executives appear before NCPCR over CSEAM
stories.summary: Meta has submitted its response following the appearance of Meta India chief Arun Srinivas and senior executives of the company before NCPCR last month over the inquiry instituted after it took cognisance of allegations concerning paid s on Instagram that allegedly facilitated access to Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM)/CSEAM. Meta’s response is under scrutiny, sources in NCPCR said.

stories.title: Vanessa Hudgens bought a 1922 LA home for $5 million; after renovation, she sold it for $6.7 million
stories.summary: In 2018, Vanessa Hudgens acquired a charming historic residence in Los Angeles from Gary Oldman for almost $5 million. She renovated and redesigned the space, ultimately selling it to Ronan Farrow and Jon Lovett in February 2022 for an impressive $6.725 million. The 1922-built house, fondly known as Little DeMille, boasted rich heritage, beautiful gardens, and artistic enhancements by Hudgens, showcasing her flair for style.

stories.title: Ellis Building Hotel Conversion: Aperture buys site for $10.3m; Marriott Tribute Portfolio rooms planned
stories.summary: The iconic Ellis Building, erected in 1922, is set to undergo a transformation into a chic boutique hotel, managed by Aperture Hotels and affiliated with Marriott's Tribute Portfolio. This revitalization aims to breathe new life into the historic space, following previous redevelopment failures. The project promises about 95 to 105 stylish guest rooms, complemented by a modern restaurant and bar, aligning with similar projects in downtown Phoenix.

stories.title: 21 years on, double life term for Jammu terror attack that killed baby, 2 others
stories.summary: In his order on Wednesday, principal sessions judge Ramban Ajay Kumar Gupta rejected defence arguments that the attack had taken place more than two decades ago when Sharief was young, his long incarceration and possibility of rehabilitation. Besides the life sentences, the court imposed two separate terms of 10 years on Sharief under various sections pertaining to murder and arms act offences.

stories.title: Govt defends cancellation of Wangchuk institute’s land allotment, alleges role in last year’s unrest
stories.summary: The claims have been made in an affidavit filed on Wednesday in which Wangchuk is also accused of inciting “violence in Leh on Sept 24, 2025” in which four people were killed and scores injured in alleged police firing on protesters demanding statehood and Sixth Schedule status for the Union territory (UT) of Ladakh.

stories.title: Engineer Builds Rental Business: Ohio couple turns cave into cash; social media drives bookings
stories.summary: Bryant Gingerich and his wife Amy turned a sprawling 34-acre land into a thriving hospitality destination known as Dunlap Hollow. This charming getaway features an array of unique accommodations, including a quaint cottage, an A-frame, and an adventurous cave stay. By leveraging social media marketing, they attracted a steady stream of guests, leading to impressive profits.

stories.title: Roe 8 Corridor Rehabilitation: 200,000 plants and 97 species return; ecosystem only 30% restored
stories.summary: Almost ten years post the controversial Roe 8 highway initiative, Western Australia is witnessing a promising wave of ecological recovery. Recent studies have reported a remarkable resurgence of local wildlife and native plant life. Rehabilitation efforts, which have culminated in planting over 280,000 seedlings, are welcoming back species such as Carnaby’s black cockatoos.

stories.title: Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk
stories.summary: Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed.

stories.title: New norms to limit fuel leaks, protect EV batteries in rear-end crashes
stories.summary: In a notification, road transport ministry has also made the automotive standard, AIS-192, mandatory for Event Data Recorder (EDR) from Oct 2029 if it is installed in any car. The EDR feature is not mandatory for all cars, and it remains an optional feature. EDR records crash details, which help establish what happened immediately before and during a collision. It is similar in purpose to an aircraft’s flight-data recorder.

stories.title: DHS can't knock on the doors and ask people about their immigration status, rules federal judge
Olivia Wilde sells Studio City home for nearly $1m less than asking
stories.summary: Olivia Wilde recently offloaded her Studio City residence for $5.23 million, a price tag that fell short of her original purchase. Designed by architect Barbara Bestor, the home boasted a sleek modern-ranch aesthetic. Initially on the market for $6.2 million, the sale concluded in December, adding to her previous real estate transaction in Silver Lake, sold at $4.2 million. Meanwhile, rumors swirl about her relationship with art dealer Caspar Jopling.

stories.title: Amazon loses 240 million acres of forest, risking rainfall disruption
stories.summary: According to a recent report, the Amazon has lost 97 million hectares of primary forest by 2025. Most forest loss is attributed to human activity, particularly land clearing and fires. The disruptions to moisture pathways during dry seasons raise critical concerns for the ecosystem. A strong El Niño expected in late 2026 could exacerbate these issues and increase fire risks.

stories.title: PM Modi calls for stronger global institutions; takes ‘failed product’ jab at Congress
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for stronger global institutions during his address at the NDTV World Summit. He argued that the current global system struggles to address new challenges, particularly in international relations. Modi also criticized Congress leadership for failing to effectively launch their leader, calling it a burden on the party. Furthermore, he highlighted India's role in international cooperation, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic.

stories.title: North Dakota farmer to earn $5,250 a year for turning erosion-prone land into grassland
stories.summary: In North Dakota, a retired farmer is turning erosion-susceptible farmland into lush grassland to secure annual earnings. Through a state conservation program, he anticipates earning $5,250 over five years. This initiative encourages farmers to repurpose unproductive land, benefiting wildlife and soil health. With interest exceeding available funds, discussions are underway to seek federal assistance to enhance the program's impact on farm income and conservation.

stories.title: Hawaii coral study finds reef sounds help larvae settle on coated structures
CEC impeachment: Speaker Om Birla says fresh motion against Gyanesh Kumar will be examined as per rules
Man builds WWII-style bunker beneath his garden with 35ft tunnel and hidden beer lift
stories.summary: Dave Billings, a fabricator from Derbyshire, has dedicated 11 years to creating an underground garden project. His construction includes two bunkers connected by a long passage, which was inspired by World War II escape tunnels. Billings designed a lift disguised as a beer keg to facilitate drink delivery underground. He plans to connect the bunkers to his home through a concealed entrance leading to an old well.

stories.title: A Texas man turned 10 acres into a $100,000-a-year glamping business with just $12,000 down
stories.summary: Garrett Brown launched Cameron Ranch Glamping on a picturesque 10-acre plot in Houston, beginning with a minimal budget. He cleverly applied land hacking methods that streamlined utility connections while steering clear of complicated planning processes. The business flourished initially with a geodome, later evolving through zero-cost revenue-sharing arrangements. Rather than relying on third-party bookings, he focused on direct guest engagement, chronicling his experiences in his book, The Glamping Investor.

stories.title: Natco’s generic SMA drug approved; ‘clinical trial’ labels trigger Kerala row
stories.summary: CDSCO says no bioequivalence study required for oral solution; company says labels on free bottles were part of standard packaging protocol

stories.title: Indiana lawmaker resigns after he was caught shoplifting from Walmart stores. He says he's under medical evaluation for cognitive decline
